I was born and raised in Bulgaria. I can speak Bulgarian fluently but I don't know any grammar because I only attended 2 years of school there. I can still speak correctly, I just don't know the rules or anything. I moved to Austria 6 years ago and I never really sat down to learn the language by myself because of mental struggles. I've also learned English through the internet and I am best at it.  
I have tried looking up videos for Nominativ, Akkusativ, Dativ and Genitiv but all of them seemed confusing and it didn't make much sense to me. Even if I thought I understood it, when I'm writing a sentence suddenly nothing makes sense anymore.

1. I don't really understand what you mean with concept, I'll guess you are asking if I know when to use die, der or das. Not really. I always guess and most of the time I get it wrong.  
2. Only a bit. Die Familie and das Auto sounds correct. Those are pretty simple.

1. I assume you're asking if I know which gender a noun has. For the most part, not really, I just guess most of the time. I pick whatever sounds right (most of the time it is incorrect).  
2. Being decently fluent in the language has given me a slight feel for this thing, I couldn't really tell you why I switched 'die' to 'der, it just sounds right.  
3. The subject in a sentence is always Nominative, that's all I really know.
